notes: Both ἐνώπιον frames are analysed alike (rule 24), each headed on 'sight' as an improper preposition's frame (rules 71, 95) and each keeping its trailing 'of' because the governed word has no determiner for an article to anchor (rule 101).
The main-clause copula t029 is given to the predicate noun βδέλυγμα under rules 53 and 96; giving it to the substantival subject article under rule 68 remains defensible.
